name: UpdraftPlus
description_en:
UpdraftPlus is a WordPress plugin for backing up and restoring site files and databases, with migration and additional controls in its premium offering. Its official site now redirects to TeamUpdraft. UpdraftCentral management, UpdraftVault storage and UpdraftClone staging are related services with separate operational boundaries.

Current evaluation also needs the official October 2026 security-incident notice. The vendor reports customer-account and connection-key exposure and product-specific recovery actions; this profile does not treat generic security marketing as a clean bill of health. No WordPress installation was modified or tested.
description_zh:
UpdraftPlus 是备份恢复 WordPress 文件及数据库的插件，付费版本增加迁移及其他控制。官网目前重定向到 TeamUpdraft。UpdraftCentral 管理、UpdraftVault 存储和 UpdraftClone 暂存环境是相关但运维边界不同的服务。

当前评估还需阅读官方 2026 年 10 月安全事件公告。厂商报告客户账户及连接密钥暴露，并给出不同产品的处理步骤；本文不把通用安全宣传当作无风险证明。本次未修改或测试 WordPress。

sections.title_en: Keep a backup outside the site host
sections.title_zh: 在站点主机外保存备份
sections.en:
The storage guide says the default backup location is inside the site’s hosting storage and recommends a remote destination. Free supports several destinations including Google Drive, Dropbox and S3-compatible storage; Premium adds others. A plugin installation alone therefore does not create an independently accessible offsite copy.

For a pilot, back up a disposable site’s database and relevant file components to a separately accessible destination, then verify both retrieval and a restore to staging. WordPress access, destination credentials, available space and an appropriate component set are prerequisites.
sections.zh:
存储指南说明默认备份保存在站点托管空间，建议另设远程目标。免费版支持 Google Drive、Dropbox、S3 兼容存储等，Premium 增加其他目标。因此，单纯安装插件不会自动形成可独立访问的异地副本。

试点可把可丢弃站点数据库及相关文件组件备份到可独立访问的目标，再验证取回及恢复到暂存环境。需要 WordPress 访问、目标凭据、可用空间和合适组件范围。

sections.title_en: Choose components, retention and evidence of completion
sections.title_zh: 选择组件、保留及完成证据
sections.en:
The restoration guide distinguishes database, uploads, plugins and themes; restoring a database can replace newer site state, so inspect the recovery point and selected components. Premium retention rules can retain recent copies more densely than older ones and can differ between files and database.

Advanced reports include completion information and checksums, but a report is not a substitute for opening the restored site. Before an update-recovery exercise, define which content changes may be lost, test on staging and inspect logs or warnings when a run is incomplete.
sections.zh:
恢复指南区分数据库、上传、插件和主题，恢复数据库可能替换较新站点状态，需检查恢复点及组件。Premium 保留规则可让近期副本更密、旧副本更疏，文件与数据库规则可不同。

高级报告包含完成信息和校验值，但报告不能代替打开恢复后的站点。更新回退演练前，应明确允许丢失哪些内容变化，在暂存环境测试；未完整执行时检查日志或警告。

sections.title_en: October 2026 incident changes the onboarding checklist
sections.title_zh: 2026 年 10 月事件影响接入检查
sections.en:
As read on 22 October, TeamUpdraft says its site/customer database was accessed, including hashed passwords and connection keys. It says plugin downloads and backups in customers’ own remote storage were not directly affected, while connected sites may have been accessed through UpdraftCentral. The notice asks Premium users to check for unusual users/plugins even if they did not knowingly use Central.

The vendor describes account-password/2FA changes, revoked Central keys, Vault reconnection and new Clone keys. Vault backups do not arrive until reconnection. Follow the current notice for the relevant product and verify a new backup; this evolving vendor statement is not an independent incident investigation or proof that every affected site is clean.
sections.zh:
截至 10 月 22 日读取，TeamUpdraft 称网站／客户数据库被访问，涉及哈希密码和连接密钥；插件下载及客户自有远程存储备份未直接受影响，但连接站点可能经 UpdraftCentral 被访问。公告要求 Premium 用户检查异常用户／插件，即使不记得使用过 Central。

厂商说明应修改账户密码／2FA，Central 密钥已撤销，Vault 需重连，Clone 密钥已更换；Vault 重连前收不到备份。应按当前公告处理对应产品并验证新备份。这是持续更新的厂商说明，不是独立事件调查或每个站点已清洁的证明。

sections.title_en: Pay for site allowance and included services
sections.title_zh: 按站点额度及包含服务购买
sections.en:
The current product page lists annual Premium plans: Personal USD 70 for up to two sites, Business USD 95 for ten, Agency USD 145 for 35, Enterprise USD 195 for unlimited sites and Gold USD 399 with additional storage. Plan names do not establish unlimited storage, hosting or staging resources. Free and Premium capabilities must be checked separately.

Shortlist it for WordPress-specific backup/recovery when the component and destination controls fit. It does not back up an arbitrary server environment. Confirm renewal, included storage/staging allowances, host compatibility and the latest incident instructions before adoption. No final checkout or restore result was verified.
sections.zh:
当前产品页列 Premium 年付：Personal 70 美元最多两站，Business 95 美元十站，Agency 145 美元 35 站，Enterprise 195 美元不限站，Gold 399 美元另含存储。套餐名称不代表存储、主机或暂存资源不限量，免费与付费能力需分别核对。

需要 WordPress 专用备份恢复且组件和目标控制适配时，可考虑它，不能用于推断任意服务器环境备份。采用前需确认续费、存储／暂存额度、主机兼容及最新事件说明；本文未验证最终结账或恢复结果。
